ports.note: Output reuses the host decisions port so existing Map, Table and Chart widgets present it unchanged.

ontology.note: Pack namespace only; mints no host term.

changes.description: Compares a projected level against a practitioner-supplied elevation on a stated vertical datum, and classifies the result. A comparison of two numbers, not an inundation model.

evidence.note: No implementation exists. Accounts for no hydrodynamics, defences, drainage or waves. Refuses to run without a stated vertical datum, and refuses connection to a raster output, which would render something resembling a flood map.
